verdict.rationale: An infrastructure control plane could plausibly ship natural-language operation, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no such interface. Crossplane is driven through declarative Kubernetes APIs, YAML/KCL/Python/Go functions, and a conventional CLI. The marketing claim that its declarative APIs are something 'AI systems can safely act on' describes a building block for external agents, not a natural-language command capability of the product itself.
